ModMetaData.name: Lizarb Interface
ModMetaData.author: Lizarb
ModMetaData.description:
A complete reskin of RimWorld's interface.
- 14 themes, each with its own palette, corner geometry and ornament - 9 tileable background patterns - Font selection with a real text outline - Window frames, tabs, buttons, tooltips, checkboxes, gizmos, scrollbars - Colours every Architect category button by what the category is for
Every surface can be turned off on its own, so it can share the screen with other UI mods. Load it last if you want its look to win.
